sloka: सो ऽर्चिःपिनद्धो ददृशे होमशोणिततर्पितः।सन्ध्यागत इवादित्यः सुतीव्रो ऽग्निः समुत्थितः ।। ६.८२.२८ ।।
transliteration: so 'rciḥpinaddho dadṛśe homaśoṇitatarpitaḥ।sandhyāgata ivādityaḥ sutīvro 'gniḥ samutthitaḥ ।। 6.82.28 ।।

translations.english: Then Indrajit, for the prosperity of the rakshasas, duly offered oblations according to rite; and beholding it, those rakshasas, knowing right policy from wrong, stood firm in their vast ranks.
